pages.text: The sun was high. Taro and Mumu sat under the well tree. Both were hungry.
"Let's have something to eat." "Let's!" They shouted at the same time, "I'll bring it!"
Each heard only their own words. Taro thought he was bringing the food. Mumu thought they were bringing it, too.
Taro ran to his yard. Low branches were full of bananas. His hands were very quick.
Mumu ran to their yard, too. Standing tall, Mumu could reach the high branches and picked bananas one after another.
Taro came back with an armful of bananas. "Mumu will love these!"
Mumu came back with an armful, too. "Taro will love these!"
They stood facing each other under the tree. "Oh?" "Oh?"
They poured the bananas onto leaves. The pile reached their knees. Each ate one, then another.
Not a banana was left. Only peels and a few fallen feathers lay on the leaves. Chickens waddled away with bulging bellies. Taro and Mumu watched, mouths wide open.
